messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 FP&A + Billing Ops headcount approval — proposed splits & comp bands

Folks,

Following our capacity review yesterday, I'm proposing we move ahead with two hires for Q3 to stabilize month-end close reliability and free up senior analysts for strategic forecasting:

- 1x Senior FP&A Analyst (IC): handle revenue variance analysis and monthly product P&L breakdowns.
- 1x Billing Ops Manager: dedicated to billing platform improvements, dispute reduction, and vendor reconciliation cadence.

Attached: Q3_headcount_summary.pdf with the headcount rationale and comp-band-proposal.xlsx with suggested bands. Key asks:
1) Finance sign-off on the FP&A comp band and headcount (Marissa + Laura)
2) Approval to open requisition and engage TalentBridge + Greenfield Partners for sourcing (Vivek)
3) Steering leader buy-in on hiring timeline (Stephanie)

Budget impact: ~0.9 FTE effective additional burn this FY (see page 2 of the summary). We can offset via the open contractor reductions in rev ops.

If everyone is OK, I'll submit the requisition (requisition-JW-238.docx) and kick off outreach to the agencies — target final offer by end of July.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q3_headcount_summary.pdf (3 pages)]
[Attachment: comp-band-proposal.xlsx]

Subject: Re: Q3 FP&A + Billing Ops headcount approval — proposed splits & comp bands

Thanks, Jonas — reviewed the packet. Quick notes:

- FP&A Senior band looks reasonable; bump midpoint by 3% vs. proposal to hit market in SF Bay (see comp-band-proposal.xlsx tab 'market_adj').
- Billing Ops Manager: prefer hiring at midpoint but include a $7k sign-on for transfers from billing vendors to make the switch attractive.

From a budget standpoint we can cover the incremental 0.9 FTE this FY if we defer one contractor renewal in Support for Q3. I put a short note on page 4.

Approve to open the FP&A req pending the 3% midpoint adjustment and the standard headcount form submission to People Ops.

Marissa
